title: LLV-G125GPA: precision equal to arity sharpens both lower-order envelopes

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single LLV-G125GPA configuration in proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY branch, charged work is O(2^((1/8)sqrt nlog2n+(1/2)sqrt n+(5/8)n^(3/8)log2n+4n^(3/8))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. The main branch n>=2^4096 computes v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2n),a=ceil(n^(1/8)),P_prec=a,B_src=floor(v/2)-a-100ell,H_prec=bit_length(a^a-1),m=floor(a*B_src/H_prec),kappa=ceil(log2(m+a))+3,lambda=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*(a-1))). All parameters use uniform integer arithmetic; preprocessing has polynomial cost and memory in n. The finite exhaustive branch, fixed Grover schedules, exact phase instrument, caps and two all-modulus decoders are explicit. All serial lookup/list exclusion, addresses, circuit/gate generation, failed work, discarded copies, measurements, resets and cleanup are charged. Section14 proves the displayed leading terms with3n^(3/8)+o(n^(3/8)), leaving positive unit slack to the stated4n^(3/8), jointly with all other claims.

For the same LLV-G125GPA configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical workspace is O(2^((1/4)n^(3/8)log2n+(1/4)n^(1/4)log2n+7n^(1/4))) bits, with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index3/8. Section14 proves lambda at most(1/4)n^(3/8)log2n+(1/4)n^(1/4)log2n+6n^(1/4)+o(n^(1/4)); the positive unit gap absorbs every fixed polynomial storage factor. Tables, residue arrays, verified tuple lists, search schedules, arithmetic, counters, caps, extraction scratch and streamed decoders are included, jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For the same LLV-G125GPA algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum allocation on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including all retained phase inputs, variable-arity siblings, finishing levels, fresh U=a*lambda search registers, reusable oracle and reflection scratch, rank/projection registers, source transforms and extraction ancillas. Each search trial resets/releases its ancillas before the next trial. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0, jointly with success at least1-2^-8 and all other resource/error claims.

For the same LLV-G125GPA algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies, number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)) with an absolute outside constant. The literal main hard cap nCcap+K is at most2^((1/2)sqrt n) by the exact integer depth budget m*H_prec<=P_prec*B_src, with Dbar=2^a K lambda a^m,Dcap=2^12 nDbar,Ccap=2^13 nDbar. The exact envelope has growth index1/2, jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-G125GPA algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
